summary: CEIR-21 sec-35 ceir.shape: OWN symbolic + dynamic SHAPE reasoning as authored CEIR — the value-op dialect over the CEIR-3d shape TYPES (Dim/Shape, already declared TypeKinds; §21/§35). A high-level shape vocabulary a tensor program (ceir.tensor, 21b) + a provider partitioner CITE, so shape rules live in the IR — NEVER 'encoded only as ad-hoc runtime checks inside kernels' (§21). ⛔ DECLARE-only (21a): types already exist (3d), this slice adds the OPS + the module-walk verifier Context::find_shape_misuse + tests, ZERO renderer changes, crd-ceir NEVER links gpu-context (I3/I4). ⛔ ALL PURE + typed NoSemantics (value constructors/queries over shapes; no memory/device effect) — the 12a resource.declare precedent, NOT the 20a native-intrinsic tier. ⛔ NO kernel_ref, NO lowering hook on any op (§70: a NATIVE graph backend must ingest the tensor+shape graph WHOLE — never flatten a shape query to a dispatch). ⛔ CURRENCY: the ops WRAP the 3d tri-state predicates (`shapes_broadcast`→BroadcastResult, `shapes_reshape`→ShapeCompat); the VERIFIER contract is Incompatible → a POINTING misuse (the 3z BroadcastResult.position), Unknown → ACCEPT (the principled deferral 3d named — a `shape.assert` DISCHARGES it at runtime), Compatible → accept. ⛔ I6 — find_shape_misuse switches on TypeId/TypeKind, NEVER op.kind. ⛔ NO-FOLLOW / DEFERRED (declared != implemented — a later slice with a real consumer, never a silent subset): symbolic-dim EXPRESSIONS (add/mul/floordiv over Symbolic dims — §35 'symbolic expressions'; the arith-over-Dim algebra) land when a specializing consumer needs them; specialization-from-observed-shapes (§21) is a provider/JIT concern (CEIR-24+); layout constraints (§22) are CEIR-21c; the sparse-format encoding is CEIR-23 (struck from 3d @ band-open). ⛔ `shape.assert` is a runtime GUARD — for THIS declare-only slice it carries typed NoSemantics + is modeled Pure (no effect family fits a control guard; §26 stops at Debug); the CANONICALIZER-must-not-fold-it-to-identity contract is NAMED-FORWARD to CEIR-6 canonicalization (no DCE/fold pass targets ceir.shape today, so the concern is theoretical until a consumer runs one).

ops.name: assert
ops.summary: A runtime shape-relation check (the Unknown discharge): assert `relation` between two Shapes, pass %lhs through.
ops.docs: shape.assert(%lhs, %rhs) {relation} -> %shape. The runtime shape check (§21 runtime shape checks / shape assertions) that DISCHARGES a static Unknown: assert `lhs relation rhs` at runtime (else trap), pass %lhs through. `relation` closed vocab {equal|broadcast|reshape}. Pure for declare-only (typed NoSemantics); ⛔ a canonicalizer must NOT fold it to identity (it is a guard) -- named-forward to CEIR-6. find_shape_misuse: operands Shape-typed (OperandNotShape), result == %lhs type (AssertResultMismatch), `relation` present+String+in-vocab (AssertRelationInvalid). STRUCTURAL (2 operands, 1 result, `relation` present+String): the generated verify_assert.

operands.name: lhs
operands.doc: the Shape asserted + passed through (a 3d Shape TypeKind).

operands.name: rhs
operands.doc: the Shape `lhs` is asserted against (a 3d Shape TypeKind).

results.name: shape
results.doc: = %lhs, now asserted to satisfy `relation` with %rhs (a refined shape downstream ops rely on).

attributes.name: relation
attributes.doc: the asserted relation, a CLOSED vocab: equal | broadcast | reshape. find_shape_misuse rejects any other token (AssertRelationInvalid).

ops.name: broadcast
ops.summary: The numpy-broadcast RESULT shape of two Shapes (wraps the 3d shapes_broadcast predicate; Unknown defers to shape.assert).
ops.docs: shape.broadcast(%lhs, %rhs) -> %shape. The numpy-broadcast result shape of two Shapes (§35 broadcast); the producer for 21b elementwise. Pure. find_shape_misuse WRAPS 3d shapes_broadcast: Incompatible -> ShapeBroadcastIncompatible pointing the right-aligned position (BroadcastResult.position, the 3z diag); Unknown -> ACCEPT (the principled deferral -- symbolic/dynamic dims discharge at a shape.assert); Compatible -> accept. operands + result Shape-typed (OperandNotShape / ResultNotShape). ⛔ RESULT EXACTNESS (result == the exact computed broadcast shape) is NAME-FORWARDED to CEIR-21b: it needs a `shapes_broadcast_result(a,b) -> TypeId` helper whose consumer is 21b's `ceir.tensor` elementwise (the producer 3d lacked); 21a enforces compat + result-KIND only (make/extent/reshape DO enforce result-identity here — broadcast is the sole deferral). STRUCTURAL (2 operands, 1 result, no attrs): the generated verify_broadcast.

results.name: shape
results.doc: the broadcast-result Shape (numpy align-right rule). Well-typed when shapes_broadcast(lhs,rhs) is Compatible or Unknown; find_shape_misuse rejects Incompatible.

ops.name: extent
ops.summary: The extent Dim at `axis` of a Shape (axis bounds-checked against a statically-known rank).
ops.docs: shape.extent(%shape) {axis} -> %dim. The extent Dim at `axis` of a Shape (§35 extents). Pure. find_shape_misuse: operand Shape-typed (OperandNotShape), result Dim-typed (ExtentResultNotDim), `axis` present+Int+>=0 and (statically-ranked) axis < rank (ExtentAxisInvalid). STRUCTURAL (1 operand, 1 result, `axis` present+Int): the generated verify_extent.

operands.name: shape
operands.doc: the Shape whose axis-`axis` extent is queried (a 3d Shape TypeKind).

results.name: dim
results.doc: the extent at `axis` = the Shape's member Dim at that axis (Static/Symbolic/Dynamic).

attributes.name: axis
attributes.doc: the axis index (>=0). find_shape_misuse: present + Int + >=0, AND < rank when the Shape's rank is statically known (ExtentAxisInvalid); a dynamic-rank Shape defers the upper bound to runtime.

ops.name: make
ops.summary: Construct a Shape from ordered Dim operands (0 dims = the rank-0 !shape<> scalar-shape); a Pure value constructor.
ops.docs: shape.make(%dims...) -> %shape. Construct a Shape value from ordered Dim operands (§35 shape values); RANK = operand count (0 = the rank-0 !shape<>). Pure (a value constructor, no effect). find_shape_misuse: every operand Dim-typed (MakeOperandNotDim, pointing the first offender), result Shape-typed (ResultNotShape). STRUCTURAL (0+ operands, 1 result, no attrs): the generated verify_make.

operands.name: dims
operands.doc: the shape's dimensions in axis order (each a 3d Dim value -- Static/Symbolic/Dynamic); 0 operands = a rank-0 shape (!shape<>).

results.name: shape
results.doc: the constructed Shape value (a 3d Shape TypeKind whose members are the operand dims, in order).

ops.name: rank
ops.summary: The RANK (dimension count) of a Shape, as an Index.
ops.docs: shape.rank(%shape) -> %rank. The rank (dimension count) of a Shape (§35 rank), as an Index. Pure. find_shape_misuse: operand Shape-typed (OperandNotShape), result Index-typed (RankResultNotIndex). STRUCTURAL (1 operand, 1 result, no attrs): the generated verify_rank.

operands.name: shape
operands.doc: the Shape whose rank is queried (a 3d Shape TypeKind).

results.name: rank
results.doc: the rank = the Shape's dimension count, as an Index.

ops.name: reshape
ops.summary: Validate a reshape from a source Shape to a target Shape (wraps the 3d shapes_reshape predicate); result = the validated target.
ops.docs: shape.reshape(%src, %target) -> %shape. Validate a reshape src -> target (§35 reshape compatibility); result = the validated target Shape. Pure. find_shape_misuse WRAPS 3d shapes_reshape (static element-product equality, u32-overflow -> Unknown): Incompatible -> ShapeReshapeIncompatible; Unknown -> ACCEPT (dynamic/symbolic total discharges at a shape.assert); Compatible -> accept. operands + result Shape-typed (OperandNotShape / ResultNotShape). STRUCTURAL (2 operands, 1 result, no attrs): the generated verify_reshape.

operands.name: src
operands.doc: the SOURCE Shape being reshaped (a 3d Shape TypeKind).

operands.name: target
operands.doc: the TARGET Shape (a 3d Shape TypeKind); element-count-compatible with src (shapes_reshape).

results.name: shape
results.doc: the validated target Shape (= the `target` operand's type). Well-typed when shapes_reshape(src,target) is Compatible or Unknown.
